method: HISTORICAL snapshot through 83420da: Git history, supplied-document hashes, implementation, adjacent tests and frozen pre-M33 solver output. Superseded for the newly read wind/combination subset by supplied-source-review-m33a.json; PDFs remain private.
historicalNotice: ENGINE-NORMATIVE-TRACEABILITY.md explicitly marks its initial no-full-text/no-implementation table as historical. Later user-supplied sources and implementations supersede that initial snapshot.

procedures.scope: Existing partial original-edition formulas, flat terrain and uniform roughness only; V0, classification and S3 remain declared dependencies; this is not complete wind assessment
procedures.available: S1=1 in its restricted domain; b,p,zg,zmin for I-V/A-C; Fr=[1,.98,.95] from II; S2=b*Fr*(max(z,zmin)/10)^p; Vk=V0*S1*S2*S3; q=.613*Vk^2; reference density 1.226 kg/m3
procedures.independentComparison: REF-04 S2=0.913 at 7.5m, III/A (3 printed decimals); REF-01 exposure only, II/B at 4.65m, S2=0.92 (2 decimals); conflicting V0 retained

procedures.available: User-supplied original document and existing q*(Cpe-Cpi) distributor; existing zone examples are synthetic declarations
procedures.missing: Recoverable numeric rows identifying item/table/figure, roof geometry, incidence, exact slope, openings and every Cpi alternative; absence is of a usable transcription, not of a historically supplied document

procedures.available: User-supplied capture, 18 PDF pages; earlier visual review through printed page 23, tables/formulae recorded as examined; existing compiler multiplies declared gamma*psi and enforces exclusivity
procedures.missing: Versioned numerical gamma/psi rows and purpose/class/leading/accompanying/favorable/adverse domains with per-value citations; no safe reconstruction from review metadata alone
procedures.compatibility: NBR14762:2010 cites NBR8681:2003 and contains its own 6.7. No 2003 factors or resistance gammas are substituted for 2025 action factors.

procedures.scope: Existing tested formulas only, subject to current Ue geometry, mode, energy, load and release gates; automatic results require evaluator /4; no full-member or fabrication approval
procedures.available: Compression MRD gamma 1.20; bending MRD 1.10; tension gross 1.10, net-outside 1.35, net-connection 1.65; C.5 effective inertia; unstiffened single-web shear kv=5; concomitant N/M interactions; axial-joint demand minimum max(|Nsd|,.5*valid axial resistance)
procedures.validation: Existing independent Decimal resistance controls and M31/M32 section/eigenmode campaigns; conditional dependencies and unsupported torsion/connections retained
procedures.reuseInM33A: Preserve existing procedures; never use their resistance gammas as NBR8681 action factors

procedures.errata: Errata 1:2025 recorded in first five PDF pages
procedures.available: User-supplied 298-page file with separate errata; source inventory available; no complete NBR8800 resistance implementation is established by the reviewed code
procedures.reuseInM33A: Keep provenance; new resistance implementation is outside scope

procedures.available: User-supplied 66-page file; existing explicit density/self-weight and roof-area physical load paths
